newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Filipinos shave heads, fast in APEC protest.
newsitem.headline: Filipinos shave heads, fast in APEC protest.

text.p: Five Filipinos shaved their heads with scissors and razor blades and more than 30 others launched a protest fast in front of a Philippine church on Wednesday to protest against Monday's APEC summit.

"This is our way of showing what APEC will do to our country. Foreign companies will come and exploit our cheap labour and deplete our environnment," housewife Jesusa Rebite, 30, told reporters while fellow demonstrators gave her and four male activists a crude shave with scissors and blades.

The first one to lose his hair had a "No to APEC" written in red on his shaven head, which he showed to curious passersby as he sat on the steps of the Philippine Independence Church on Manila's congested Taft Avenue.
Their fasting colleagues said they would not have any solid food for the next 24 hours. Nearby, they laid an effigy of a farmer with stakes labelled "APEC" driven into the body.

The annual meeting of the 18 members of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum began in Manila on Wednesday, with officials laying the groundwork for the summit on Monday in nearby Subic to discuss the group's stated goals of free trade in the region.
